settings.logoAlt: Psalm 23 Transportation logo: a bronze and forest-green heavy-duty flatbed truck in a puzzle pattern

hero.intro: Family-owned flatbed hauling for equipment, materials, and other items that need moving. Tell us what, where, and when; we’ll help you plan the next step.
hero.ribbon: PUTTING THE PIECES TOGETHER, FROM PICKUP TO DELIVERY.

services.intro: Every job starts with the details. We’ll discuss what needs moving, the route, and your timeframe before confirming availability and pricing.

cards.title: Equipment & materials
cards.description: Need equipment, supplies, or bulky items transported? Share the dimensions, approximate weight, and pickup details so we can discuss the job.

cards.title: Scrap & cleanup transport
cards.description: Moving scrap metal or clearing materials from a property? Tell us what needs collecting and where it should be delivered.

cards.title: Local & longer-distance trips
cards.description: From nearby pickups to longer journeys, share the starting point, destination, and preferred date. We’ll confirm what’s possible.

story.paragraph1: Psalm 23 Transportation is a family-owned business founded by Isabella, her boyfriend, and her dad. Their shared Christian faith is at the heart of what they are building together.
story.paragraph2: Like the interlocking pieces on our truck, every successful journey depends on the details coming together. We aim to communicate clearly, treat people fairly, and approach every job with care.
story.verse: “The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not want.”

quote.intro: Tell us what needs transporting, where it should be collected, and where it’s going. We’ll review the details and get back to you about availability and a quote.
quote.smallNote: Prefer a quick conversation? Call, text, or email us directly.
quote.loadPlaceholder: Describe the items, estimated size or weight, and any special details
quote.dateLabel: When do you need it moved? (optional)
quote.disclaimer: Opens a message in your texting app. Please review and send it yourself; your request is not sent automatically.
